news.headline: Ghani Value Glass announces financial results for the year ended June 30, 2026
news.summary: PSX posted Ghani Value Glass's financial results notice for the year ended June 30, 2026; logged as a notable official result filing.

news.headline: OLP Modaraba announces financial results for the year ended June 30, 2026
news.summary: PSX posted OLP Modaraba's financial results notice for the year ended June 30, 2026; logged as a notable official result filing.

news.headline: Agro Processors & Atmospheric Gases makes PSX debut on 15 September
news.summary: Agro Processors & Atmospheric Gases Limited began trading on the PSX Main Board on September 15, 2026 under SOYASUP with T+1 settlement. Logged as impact 2, a minor company item.

news.headline: Supernet Technologies' Rs915mn rights issue attracts 98.16% subscription
news.summary: Supernet Technologies received nearly Rs898 million against its approximately Rs914.77 million rights issue, a 98.16% subscription rate with 1.84% unsubscribed; proceeds are intended for working capital and project funding. Logged as impact 3, a notable financing item.

news.headline: PTC, BAFL, KEL, FATIMA enter KSE-30
news.summary: The PSX KSE-30 periodic recomposition took effect on September 15, 2026: PTC, BAFL, KEL and FATIMA entered while AIRLINK, Ghandhara Automobiles, Ghandhara Industries and SSGC were removed. Logged as impact 4 for an index reconstitution.

news.headline: SBP flags stronger banking resilience, 9.1% balance sheet growth in H1CY26
news.summary: SBP reported banking-sector balance sheets grew 9.1% to Rs68,997 billion in H1CY26, with the largest government-securities increases in MTBs, Ijara Sukuk and PIBs. Logged as impact 3, notable sector news.

news.headline: Pakistan Petroleum announces financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026
news.summary: PSX posted Pakistan Petroleum's official financial-results notice for the year ended June 30, 2026; no figures are logged because the announcement PDF was not text-readable in this sweep. Logged as impact 3, a notable result event.

news.headline: Gharibwal Cement announces financial results for the year ended 30.06.2026
news.summary: PSX posted Gharibwal Cement's official financial-results notice for the year ended June 30, 2026; no figures are logged because the announcement PDF was not text-readable in this sweep. Logged as impact 3, a notable result event.

news.headline: Draft Right Offer Document of LSEFSL Circular u/s 83 of Companies Act, 2017
news.summary: PSX posted LSE Financial Services' draft right-offer document under section 83 of the Companies Act, 2017. Logged as impact 3, a notable financing development.

news.headline: FNEL unusual movement in price
news.summary: PSX posted First National Equities' unusual-price-movement notice; the filing does not establish a cause in the announcement title. Logged as impact 2, a minor company item.

news.headline: Names of Directors Elected at the Election of Directors held at EGM 2026
news.summary: PSX posted Pakistan Petroleum's notice naming directors elected at its 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Logged as impact 3, notable governance news.

news.headline: PSX: Selling returns as KSE-100 loses nearly 1,400 points
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the KSE-100 settled at 168,021.80 on September 16, down 1,370.52 points or 0.81%, as elevated oil prices and regional tensions weighed on sentiment.

news.headline: Pakistan secures Sept fuel, eyes US crude via VLCC as conflict threatens fuel supplies
news.summary: Pakistan's petroleum minister said September fuel supplies are secured and October is covered under adverse scenarios, while the government is evaluating alternate crude routes and VLCC ship-to-ship transfers amid regional disruption.

news.headline: Oil slips on US stock build, Middle East disruptions limit losses
news.summary: Business Recorder reported Brent crude futures fell 0.67% to $108.02 a barrel, while supply disruptions remained; both benchmarks had settled more than $3 higher on Tuesday.

news.headline: WTL placed in non-compliant segment again after court dismisses relief plea
news.summary: Mettis Global reported WTL was placed back in PSX's Non-Compliant Segment and excluded from NCCPL SLB-B and margin-financing eligibility, with a December 14, 2026 compliance deadline.
